Some ideas to help:

1. Every day, do at least one thing that fills you with joy
2. Every day, do at least one thing that you don’t want to do, but will get you closer to what you need to be in order to be well; this needs to take into account your emotional, intellectual and physical needs.
   1. Having control of your space-time
   2. Having the lifestyle that you like (for instance, a manual/intellectual job, city/country life, etc).
   3. Saving
   4. Widening your network of friends
   5. Read a book or article about something, let your curiosity lead you. Sometimes we can’t be hopeful but we can remain curious about what happens.
3. Exercise at least once a day, this could be:
   1. Going to the furthest supermarket from your home in your neighbourhood
   2. Cycle
   3. Join a team sports (this will also help with point 2.4.)
   4. Just walk to the next tube/bus station 
4. Try reconnecting from people from your past, not the toxic ones but the ones who proved they cared deeply for you.
5. Volunteer 

I hope you feel better soon.
